name: io.github.mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents
title: Mattermost
description: Official Mattermost MCP server, built into the Mattermost Agents plugin. Read, search and post.

mattermost_host.description: Hostname of your own Mattermost server (add a port or subpath if your Site URL has one), for example chat.example.com. Requires the Mattermost Agents plugin with its HTTP MCP server enabled.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration is the default and needs no header. To use a Mattermost Personal Access Token instead, set this to Bearer followed by the token.

personal_access_token.description: Mattermost Personal Access Token (User Settings > Security > Personal Access Tokens).
